summary: Cadence Design Systems  stock is rising in the Tuesday premarket after the chip-design company reported better-than-expected earnings and reaffirmed its positioning as an artificial-intelligence beneficiary.  Cadence reported adjusted earnings of $2.11 a share in the second quarter, up from $1.65 a year ago and above analysts’ consensus estimate of $2.05, according to FactSet.  Cadence lifted its full-year guidance for adjusted earnings per share to between $8.05 and $8.15, up from a previous range of $7.85 to $7.95.
